scope: Local scoped browser/MCP saved-view workflows; no live tests or deployment

checks.name: Release application and all three Worker dry builds
Full Workspace after stored identity guard
Focused original grant receipt recovery requalification
Packaged skill, changed prose, strict future, repository consistency and whitespace

acceptance_evidence: New canonical list_saved_task_views/query_saved_task_view reads advertise and enforce tasks:read on public/private routes. Exact view ID plus paging cannot override saved predicates or supply account identity. Canonical read errors expose unavailable without fabricated counts or mutation uncertainty.

Fresh document reads bind profile, connection and access epoch and verify stored workspace identity. Unsupported/malformed definitions or wrong workspace documents fail unavailable; missing/archived views and stale pages fail explicitly.

Native savedTaskView creation/update/archive uses independent workspace.organization.write. Existing task-write grants cannot edit saved views. Schemas, OAuth consent and browser storage disclosures name view definitions.

Actual synthetic SDK and browser API exercise create, current task/dependency evaluation, stable pages, native state changes, rename, complete query replacement, archive and original receipts. Browser-style nullable filter serialization normalizes to the same exact intent.

Original accepted query snapshots and correlation IDs survive later edits/archive and a new read-only grant. Export retains all native view history; no view action creates a task/game entry or upstream write.

Browser clients reject altered query previews/receipts, wrong provenance/profile/view/revision, inconsistent totals/continuation, malformed definitions and changed sessions. Read errors never imply an uncertain mutation.
Packaged saved-view guidance distinguishes fixed dates, active stage defaults, predicate replacement and separate action approval. A named view never grants mutation permission over matched tasks.

operations.outcome: Initial complete local regression passed. Final source review added an explicit stored workspace-ID guard and a synthetic mismatched-document control. The affected full Worker suite passed again; original receipt recovery across grant changes passed a final focused recheck.

limitations: Production saved-list controls, relative presets, optional review/reminder policy and actual host/device/account qualification remain separate.
No live test round or deployment ran; production remains on the previously published source.
